refnamediv.refpurpose: Fit an ARCH regression model to the time series y using the scoring algorithm in Engle’s original ARCH paper.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [a, b] = arch_fit(y, x, p) [a, b] = arch_fit(y, x, p, iter, gamma, a0, b0)

listitem.para: A time-series data vector up to time t-1.
A matrix of (ordinary) regressors x up to t.
The order of the regression of the residual variance.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Function arch_fit() fits an ARCH regression model to the time series `y` using the scoring algorithm in Engle’s original ARCH paper. The model is: y(t) = b(1) * x(t,1) + … + b(k) * x(t,k) + e(t), h(t) = a(1) + a(2) * e(t-1)^2 + … + a(p+1) * e(t-p)^2 where `e(t)` is N(0, h(t)). The function allows specifying the number of iterations, updating factor, and initial values for the scoring algorithm.
